SkuConfigs.Name: {{MakerAIDayPassName}}
SkuConfigs.Description: {{MakerAIName}} springs to life for {{MakerAIHours}} hours* of creative collaboration! Just equip your {{MakerPenName}} in any Rooms 2.0 room you own (including Dorms with Maker AI), and your holographic helper can... • Create images and patterns on canvases • Make objects come to life through AI-generated circuits • Generate objects from the {{MakerPenName}} inventory • Learn more about upcoming features

PurchaseSuccess.Title: Day Pass Purchased
PurchaseSuccess.Text: Up to 24 hours of {{MakerAIName}} access has been added to your account. The clock starts now, so go equip your Maker Pen in one of your R2 rooms to get started!

UpsellAnnouncement.Title: Make Rooms Magical
UpsellAnnouncement.Text: Be among the first to try Maker AI in R2 rooms! Our new Day Pass extends beyond RR+ subscribers and dorms, empowering everyone to unleash their imagination.

UsageLimitReached.Title: Energy Drained
UsageLimitReached.Text: {{MakerAIName}} hit our day pass usage limits and settled down for a power nap. Ready to wake it up with a fresh Day Pass?

TimeLimitReached.Title: Time's Up!
TimeLimitReached.Text: {{MakerAIName}} hit the day pass time limit and settled down for a power nap. Ready to wake it up with a fresh Day Pass?

UsageLimitWarning.Title: Energy Running Low
UsageLimitWarning.Text: Heads up, Maker AI is nearing day pass usage limits and will need a power nap soon. Grab another day pass to keep the magic flowing uninterrupted!

TimeLimitWarning.Title: Time Running Low
TimeLimitWarning.Text: Heads up, {{MakerAIName}} has about 1 hour left before it needs a recharge. Grab another day pass to keep the magic flowing uninterrupted!

ComingSoonToMakerAI.Title: Coming Soon to {{MakerAIName}}
ComingSoonToMakerAI.Text: There are some things Maker AI doesn't know how to do yet, and we're working on it! This includes... •understanding circuits you've edited manually •generating objects out of basic shapes •placing objects relative to other objects So, "put the lamp next to the couch" or "fix this bug in my circuit" will be confusing to Maker AI (for now).

ChatError.Title: Ready to create?
ChatError.Text: Your building bestie is taking a power nap. Wake it up with a fresh {{MakerAIDayPassName}}!

PurchaseConfirmation.Title: Up to {{MakerAIHours}} Hours of Power!
PurchaseConfirmation.Text: Once a day pass is purchased, its timer keeps running even when you're not playing. The pass can't be paused or refunded even if you hit usage limits early. {{PlatformConfirmationMessage}}

Footer.Text: By pressing "Accept & Continue to Payment", I expressly agree that access to {{MakerAIName}} will begin immediately, and I acknowledge that I will lose my right to cancel or get a refund once access starts— even if it expires early due to <u>usage limits</u>.

DayPassActiveBanner.Title: Day Pass Active
DayPassActiveBanner.Text: You currently have {{MakerAITimeLeftDynamic}} of {{MakerAIName}} access. If you buy another pass now, you'll get an additional {{MakerAIHours}} hours.

MakerAIUsageLimits.Title: {{MakerAIName}} Usage Limits and Conditions
MakerAIUsageLimits.Text: Why does Maker AI have usage limits? Maker AI is a powerful tool that allows everyone to create, but every action has a cost. Usage limits ensure we can continue to offer Maker AI to everyone. What are the usage limits? We limit day passes to many hundreds of simple requests or many dozens of our most expensive requests (e.g., images and circuits). Don’t worry—this should only affect less than 1–5% of users. What happens if I hit these limits? •If it looks like you are getting close, we will provide a warning that you're approaching the limit. • If you exceed the limit, your day pass will end early. You will be able to buy another pass and continue working. We appreciate your understanding as we work to make this tool available to all. Learn More
